description: This file contains the implementation of the Comments List feature, including the request query, the handler for processing the request, and the retrieval of comments related to an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object representing a query to list comments for an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the listing of comments for a specific article, retrieving comments from the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch comments for the article with the specified slug, throwing a NotFound error if the article does not exist.
